description: This file defines a class for local smart turn analysis using PyTorch models, specifically for on-device end-of-turn detection in audio processing. It loads a pretrained Wav2Vec2-BERT model and feature extractor, and provides a method for predicting turn endpoints based on audio input.

classes.name: LocalSmartTurnAnalyzer
classes.description: A class that performs local smart turn analysis using a PyTorch model, capable of offline end-of-turn detection in audio streams.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the analyzer by loading the pretrained model and feature extractor, setting up device configuration, and preparing the model for inference.

methods.name: _predict_endpoint
methods.description: Predicts whether an audio segment indicates the end of a turn using the loaded PyTorch model.
